scenario.task:
I want to dispute an unexplained $150 roaming charge on my bill, which requires speaking with a human specialist.

User Guide: Speak in English. When prompted, provide your phone number 514-555-0199 and SMS verification code 384920. State that you have an incorrect $150 charge on your latest bill and ask to speak with a billing representative to resolve the dispute. Confirm you are ready for the transfer.
